summary_md: **OK Kazoo ([@OKKazooo](https://x.com/OKKazooo/status/2116165296981688625))** built **MOTNGRFX**, where a locally run Gemma 4 designs a kinetic-type piece from photos, clips, music or words, LTX 2.5 renders it and LTX mattes place text behind and through the subject ([okkazoo/MOTNGRFX](https://github.com/okkazoo/MOTNGRFX)).
